policy_facts: l3rank#3 changes which UTxO some spends reveal. A private session's funding or top-up, and a Send or a Make public, that one box back from Lovejoin pays now spend a box the wallet knows is mixed before any other box: one of unknown making (someone else's deposit among them), one brought back before the wallet kept its record, or one a chain of the user's left short of its last mixes. Nothing new is sent or kept. The 18 November entry gives the order only for a Seedelf or a pool's start; adding the funding's and the Send's order is G8's and the lead's call (the verifier recommends it).

l3time#3 and l3still#2: the escape hatch's private payer (Bring one back on a stuck pool, and Bring every box back now's stuck boxes, paid from the private balance) now takes first a box whose making the wallet knows. A box of unknown making goes with the rest, ordered by whether it ties another account, then by size. That's round two's order (unreleased); 1.9.1 took any box first. Nothing new is sent or kept. Whether the 18 November sentence should name the hatch is the lead's call.

l3time#2: nothing new is kept or sent. The same depositor record the 18 November entry already covers (whose deposit, a session index or an account, kept while a seed's or a Bootstrap's entry is open) is now written on any write of the Lovejoin record, not only when the record is sorted out. It ages out as before.

l3still#4: nothing new is sent or kept. A site whose page left its wait for the unlock while another of its pages waited for the unlock is no longer refused for a while later, once the unlock has answered that wait. One whose page left a connect question unanswered still is. The policy's 'unless another of its pages is asking to connect too' leaves out a page that is waiting for the unlock (any call); naming it is a wording call.

policy_facts: Written by me this round, all inside the existing 18 November 2026 entry, and in the Lovejoin row and Koios bullet it corrects. No new date, the Effective line unchanged. Nothing the wallet sends, keeps or reveals changed: these are corrections to words.

When the wallet asks what made a box it has no record of (policy :28, :44, :93): at a pool read that finds more of your boxes than it expects (after a restore, or one someone else put in under your Seedelf's key), about all such boxes together; before Mix my boxes again takes it; before it comes back by itself from one of Lovejoin's current pools; and when you press Bring one back now or Bring one back, about those it might take ahead of one it knows, together.

When it doesn't ask: Bring every box back now (in Settings or on a pool's page), the retired pools' run, Bring one back anyway and Pay from my private balance anyway take a box without that question, and a box comes back by itself from a retired pool without it.
The entry's last sentence says what the page said before (main's words: 'after a restore, and before bringing such a box back or mixing it again') and gives the exact list above.

Kept (:93): which of your boxes are mixed, while they're in the pool; and which private session paid a deposit no mix followed, while its boxes are there and for three hours after, as for a public account's.

Selection (:93): only a box the wallet knows is mixed goes first for a Seedelf or a pool's start, and any other goes after money others paid you, unless a payment you received paid its way back, which then goes as that payment. A session's funding or a private payment also takes a box it knows is mixed before one it can't tell the making of (R4-code's l3rank#3 ranks).
